The issuer demonstrates substantial equity reserves and strong profitability with a net income of 242M on 1,264M in revenue (a ~19% net margin) and significant retained earnings of 2,506M. However, the balance sheet reflects high financial leverage, evidenced by a high total liabilities-to-assets ratio of approximately 80% and a total debt/liabilities to equity ratio exceeding 5x, which places constraint on its overall solvency profile. Balancing these robust earnings metrics against a highly leveraged capital structure aligns the company with a solid, lower-investment-grade risk profile.

DECISION: BBB
